cards.name: Star Ball
cards.summary: Every peg is Power. Ten in a row makes a Star Burst.

cards.name: Bubble Ball
cards.summary: Peg hits also make Bubble Shield.
cards.starPower: Pegs create twice as much Shield.

cards.name: Paint Ball
cards.summary: Paints every peg it touches. Painted pegs explode later.

cards.name: Rocket Ball
cards.summary: Starts slow, then speeds up after every bounce.

cards.name: Boomerang Ball
cards.summary: The first time it reaches the floor, it flies back up once.
